_comment: Answer overrides where the source key file is wrong (each verified by re-derivation + zoom-crop; 2533 also book-solution-backed). Content fix applied directly in questions.json (not an override): Q2541 stem 'is decreasing' -> 'is increasing' (f'=-6(x-3)(x+2); (-2,3)=option A is the INCREASING interval, and the true decreasing set is not among the options). Multi-keys Q2568 (B,D) and Q2574 (B,D) come from the answer-key file and are genuine 'which hold' items — NOT overridden (Q2568 verified: curve y=1/x-2 has slope <0 always, so a,b same sign = B,D).

2533.reason: key 'b' wrong: f is increasing only when a-2>0, i.e. a>2 = option D (book solution agrees)

2600.reason: key 'd' wrong: the line through (0,1) with slope 3 is 3x-y+1=0 = option C; option D does not pass through (0,1)

2644.reason: key 'b' wrong: on the closed interval [-pi/2,pi/2], greatest of sin2x-x is pi/2 (at -pi/2) and least is -pi/2 (at pi/2); difference = pi = option A (key B used only interior critical points)

2648.reason: key 'c' wrong: slope s=6x+3ax^2 is max where 6+6ax=0 => x=-1/a; setting -1/a=1/2 gives a=-2 = option D

2655.reason: key 'c' wrong: f=1/(sin x+cos x) on [0,pi/2] is least when the denominator is greatest (sqrt2), giving 1/sqrt2 = sqrt2/2 = option A
